title: Canonical derived base-change morphism
statement: For a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change] X' \to X over S' \to S and a morphism f:X \to S with base change f':X' \to S', the canonical derived base-change morphism for E in D_QCoh(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] is the adjoint under Lg^* \dashv Rg_* [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image] of the composite Rf_*E \to Rf_*Rg_*Rf'_*Lg'^*E = Rg_*Rf'_*Lg'^*E induced by the unit E \to Rg'_*Lg'^*E and the canonical composition isomorphisms for derived direct images [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-composition]. For an open W\subseteq X with W'=(g')^{-1}(W), the same construction applied to the cartesian square formed by f|_W, f'|_{W'}, g and g'|_{W'} gives the derived base-change morphism Lg^*R(f|_W)_*(E|_W) \to R(f'|_{W'})_*L(g'|_{W'})^*(E|_W).
